svg.aria-label: C4 level 3, components of the agent runtime: chat surfaces, the agent API and schedules enter one session API; ChatManager, the routing lease, replay and inbound streams and the sandbox provider orchestrate the session; the Claude Code harness, MCP tools and the memory notebook run inside the sandbox; and the secret broker and egress proxy are the two fail-closed chokepoints in front of the LLM API.
